metadata.description: D-Robotics DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin marketplace — npm/git-installable dsh bundles for the RDK ecosystem.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-rdk
plugins.description: Native RDK skill catalog for DeepSeek Harness (77 skills across 5 packs: rdk-device-skills, bsp-skills, oe-skills-x5, oe-skills-s, and the rdk-skills hub). Includes the rdk_skills catalog tool, rdk_board_detect device detector, and rdk_oe_setup workspace installer (runs the official OE pack setup.sh).
